about.description: Mountain Protocol Ltd is a Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) Class F-licensed digital asset business issuing USDM, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed 1:1 by short-duration US Treasuries. Founded 2023 by Martin Carrica (ex-Buenbit) and Manuel Pacheco and headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. USDM rebases daily to pass through net Treasury yield to holders (currently ~4-5% APY net of fees) and is restricted to non-US KYC'd holders. Mountain was acquired by Anchorage Digital (announced November 2023), but continues to operate USDM under its existing BMA license. USDM is one of the first BMA-licensed yield-bearing stablecoins and competes with Ondo USDY, Sky's sUSDS, and Ethena USDe in the yield-stablecoin category.
about.registryInfo: Mountain Protocol Ltd is a Bermuda-incorporated company regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) under a Class F Digital Asset Business Act (DABA) license, granted 2023. USDM is fully backed by short-duration US Treasuries and cash held at qualified Bermuda banks. Founders: Martin Carrica (CEO, ex-Buenbit) and Manuel Pacheco. Backed by Coinbase Ventures, Multicoin Capital, Castle Island Ventures, Bankless Ventures, Distributed Global, and others. Auditor: The Network Firm LLP (proof-of-reserves). USDM was the first BMA-licensed yield-bearing stablecoin; non-US-only access model. Tether-style reserve attestations published monthly.

platform.attestationFrequency: Monthly proof-of-reserves attestation by The Network Firm LLP

fees.revenueNotes: Mountain Protocol retains a portion of the underlying Treasury yield as protocol revenue. The 50 bps estimate is based on the historical gap between Mountain's published USDM rebase rate and prevailing 4-week T-bill yields. Mountain does not publicly disclose the exact spread; figure should be verified against current FAQ or by tracking the rate differential.
